title: Export outcome says "In progress" for failed (terminal) rows
detail: Failed is a live v1 terminal state ("Something went wrong"); failed rows render the export button, and "completed" is also terminal. §7.6 exports are dispute evidence, so "Outcome: In progress" contradicts the row's terminal state.
recommended_fix: Add explicit arms before the fallback: "failed" -> "Something went wrong" and "completed" -> "Reference received", keeping `_ -> "In progress"` for genuinely live states (scheduled/calling) only.

title: New RC4.4 implementer-authored copy consts skip the em-dash pin list
detail: The standing convention (r1 W1) pins implementer-authored consts in `refcheck_action_strings`. RC4.4's new consts — `refcheck_attempt_log_title`, `refcheck_timeline_corrected`, `refcheck_timeline_taken_over`, `refcheck_timeline_substituted`, and all five `refcheck_export_*` labels — are absent, so a future em-dash in them ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add the nine new implementer-authored consts to `refcheck_action_strings()` so the global em-dash ban stays pinned for them.

title: Test fixture re-implements the server's send-batch labeling instead of pinning payload shape
detail: The fixture duplicates the server builder's kind/detail labeling (including `group_attempts_by_at`). If the server's cadence-restart labeling changes, the fixture silently diverges and the timeline tests exercise a payload shape production never ships.
recommended_fix: Drive the existing tests from explicit `attempt_log` literals (as the new RC4.4 tests already do) and drop the mirror builder, or extract the labeling into a shared-tested pure module.

title: Dropdown reference-types test bypasses the list decode it claims to guard
detail: The test constructs `Notification` values directly, so it exercises the icon match but never the fetch decoder (`notifications_response_decoder`). The whole-list-decode failure class it describes is only caught by shared codec round-trip tests.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment to claim icon-match coverage only, or add a client-side decode-level assertion feeding raw `reference_*` JSON through `notifications_response_decoder`.
